任何模型第一次连接实机时，都应先采用只读、dry-run 或最小动作范围进行检查: When connecting any model to real hardware for the first time, begin with a read-only check, a dry-run, or a minimal motion range. Allow real motion only after confirming the camera order, state dimensions, action units, and joint directions.
下面恢复原 `CalibrateREADME` 使用的 ID/OOD bench: The following restores the ID/OOD benchmark evaluation procedure used in the original `CalibrateREADME`: 20 episodes per evaluation run, a maximum of 120 seconds per episode, scene reference images used in sequence, and an evaluation seed assigned to each group of 5 episodes. The current argument parser cannot correctly handle `--dataset.rename_map`, `--scene_reference`, or `--evaluation_seed` on the command line, so these parameters are placed in the corresponding JSON configurations, with exactly the same effect as the original full commands.
ACT 直接使用 `left_global`、`left_wrist`、`rig: ACT uses `left_global`, `left_wrist`, and `right_wrist` directly, without renaming camera keys. To evaluate a different saved training step, change only `--policy.path`.
SmolVLA 必须把三路真实相机映射为 `camera1`、`camera2`: SmolVLA requires the three physical cameras to be mapped to `camera1`, `camera2`, and `camera3`. This mapping is saved in `BREE/configs/smolvla_eval.json`:
该配置默认评估 task04 drawer，任务文本和场景参考目录均已按原命令写: This configuration evaluates task04 drawer by default. The task text and scene reference directory are already set to match the original command. Before running it, confirm that the checkpoint above has been placed at that path inside the repository. If the model is still stored elsewhere, set `--policy.path` to its actual location.
XVLA 必须把三路真实相机映射为 `image`、`image2`、`imag: XVLA requires the three physical cameras to be mapped to `image`, `image2`, and `image3`. This mapping is saved in `BREE/configs/xvla_eval.json`:
三个 `BREE/configs/*_eval.json` 的结构相同，但相机编: The three `BREE/configs/*_eval.json` files share the same structure, but their camera indices and camera key mappings can differ. Do not use the configurations interchangeably.
作用与修改方法: Purpose and how to change it
要加载的模型 checkpoint。切换任务、模型或保存步数时必须修改。目录中应: The model checkpoint to load. Change it when switching tasks, models, or saved training steps. The directory should contain `config.json` and model weights.
推理设备。GPU 使用 `cuda`；只有排查兼容问题时才改为 `cpu`。: The inference device. Use `cuda` for GPU inference; switch to `cpu` only when troubleshooting compatibility.
是否启用自动混合精度。`true` 通常降低显存占用并提高 GPU 推理速度。: Whether to enable automatic mixed precision. `true` generally reduces GPU memory use and improves GPU inference speed.
左右 follower 串口。设备重新插拔后如果编号变化，需要修改 JSON。: The left and right follower serial ports. Update the JSON if reconnecting the devices changes their indices.
使用角度制状态和动作。当前三个配置均为 `true`，必须与训练数据单位一致。: Use degrees for states and actions. This is `true` in all three current configurations and must match the units in the training data.
相机设备编号。ACT/SmolVLA 配置当前为全局 0、左腕 4、右腕 2；X: Camera device indices. The current ACT/SmolVLA configurations use global 0, left wrist 4, and right wrist 2; XVLA uses global 0, left wrist 2, and right wrist 4. Confirm the actual device connections before running.
相机分辨率、帧率和编码格式。当前为 640×480、30 FPS、MJPG。修改: Camera resolution, frame rate, and encoding format. The current values are 640×480, 30 FPS, and MJPG. After changing them, ensure that all three cameras remain stably synchronized.
相机启动后的预热秒数。当前为 3 秒，可在曝光尚未稳定时适当增大。: Camera warmup time in seconds after startup. The current value is 3 seconds; increase it if exposure has not yet stabilized.
本地评估数据集名称。每次新实验应使用新名称，避免与已有数据集冲突。`push_t: The name of the local evaluation dataset. Use a new name for every new experiment to avoid conflicts with existing datasets. Even with `push_to_hub=false`, the `用户/数据集` format is recommended.
输入给 VLA 的任务文本，同时写入评估数据。必须与模型训练提示词和实际任务一致: The task text supplied to the VLA and also saved in the evaluation data. It must match both the model training prompt and the actual task. ACT does not depend on language, but this field is still recorded.
把真实相机键转换为模型训练时使用的键。ACT 为空；SmolVLA 使用 `ca: Convert physical camera keys to the keys used during model training. Leave this empty for ACT; SmolVLA uses `camera1/2/3`, and XVLA uses `image/image2/image3`.
总评估次数，当前为 20。: The total number of evaluation episodes; currently 20.
每个 episode 的最长执行时间，当前为 120 秒。: The maximum execution time for each episode; currently 120 seconds.
episode 之间的固定复位等待时间。当前为 0，表示不额外倒计时等待。: The fixed reset wait between episodes. The current value of 0 means there is no additional countdown wait.
是否自动上传评估数据。当前为 `false`，只保存在本机。: Whether to upload evaluation data automatically. This is currently `false`, so data is saved only on the local machine.
启用 `H` 键回到设定 home pose。评估前应先确保该动作路径没有碰撞风: Enable the `H` key to return to the configured home pose. Before evaluation, ensure that the motion path is free of collision risks.
回 home 的平滑运动时长，当前为 2 秒；增大可降低运动速度。: The duration of the smooth return-to-home motion; currently 2 seconds. Increasing it reduces the motion speed.
ID/OOD 场景参考图片目录。切换任务或切换到 OOD 条件时修改，例如将末尾: The directory containing ID/OOD scene reference images. Change it when switching tasks or OOD conditions, for example by replacing the final `ID` with the corresponding `OOD` directory.
用哪一路相机叠加参考图，当前为固定全局相机 `global`。: The camera used for the reference overlay; currently the fixed global camera, `global`.
参考图透明度，范围 0～1。当前 0.4；数值越大参考图越明显。: The reference image opacity, from 0 to 1. The current value is 0.4; higher values make the reference more visible.
每张参考图连续用于多少个成功 episode。当前为 1，即每次完成后切换下一张: The number of consecutive successful episodes that use each reference image. The current value is 1, so the next image is selected after each completed episode.
到达最后一张参考图后是否从第一张重新循环。20 次评估需要多轮参考图时保持 `t: Whether to loop back to the first reference image after reaching the last one. Keep this `true` when 20 evaluation episodes require multiple passes through the reference images.
第一组评估使用的 seed，当前为 0。仅对支持 `inference_seed: The seed for the first evaluation group; currently 0. This changes stochastic inference only for policies that support `inference_seed`; ACT output is largely unaffected.
每个 seed 连续使用多少个成功 episode。当前为 5，因此 20 次评: The number of consecutive successful episodes per seed. The current value is 5, dividing 20 evaluation episodes into 4 seed groups.
`true` 时场景预览阶段必须按 `H` 才会回 home；当前为 `fals: When `true`, pressing `H` is required to return home during scene preview. This is currently `false`.
是否要求 leader 与 follower 的 home 姿态对齐后才能开始。: Whether the leader and follower home poses must align before an episode can start. Policy-only evaluation has no leader, so keep this `false`.
是否显示相机和状态数据，当前为 `true`。: Whether to display camera and state data; currently `true`.
是否播放 episode 开始、结束等语音提示，当前为 `true`。: Whether to play spoken prompts for episode starts, ends, and other events; currently `true`.
`HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1` 和 `TRANSFORMERS_OFFLI: `HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1` and `TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1` force the use of local model files only; missing cached files cause an error. `PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True` helps reduce CUDA memory fragmentation. Before the first run, check the checkpoint, camera indices, task text, and `scene_reference` individually.
